text:
jamie.s: Morning — quick async standup from my side. What I did: ran NovaHealth pilot demo yesterday, updated SOW with their legal asks, and filed the follow-up notes in the account doc. Blockers: customer legal asked for BYOK/KMS architecture + HSM attestation and a timeline for on-prem private deployment. Today: drafting the KMS/HSM brief and pinging Eng for a short security blurb we can attach. Also need a 10-min pre-demo alignment with CS later. Can someone eyeball the SOW? link: https://redwood.example/sow/novahealth :pray: 

lee.a: I can take the SOW review. Will check for any pricing/commit wording that might trip procurement. If security needs a formal diagram, @sanika.s can you drop the high-level flow (customer KMS -> Redwood Private -> HSM) so legal has something to approve?

sanika.s: Yep — I have a draft diagram and a short FAQ for BYOK/HSM we've used before. I'll attach the PNG to the account doc and add notes about key wrapping and audit logs. For timeline: we can propose a pilot within 4–6 weeks depending on HSM access and network egress approvals.

oliver.sec: Quick security notes: legal will want proof of control plane separation and key lifecycle; we should include KMS integration steps and the HSM attestation letter. I can export the SOC2 excerpt and a canned line about customer-controlled keys. If they ask for HSM vendor-specific certs, we'll need a minute to confirm.

michael.so: FYI — procurement usually asks for a sample SLA for Dedicated capacity too. Jamie, do you want me to drop a placeholder SLA section in the SOW so procurement sees it early?

jamie.s: yes please @michael.so — add a placeholder and mark as draft. @lee.a thanks for review. @oliver.sec and @sanika.s if you can both drop one-paragraph blurbs we can attach as appendices. I’ll ping CS for the pre-demo slot at 3pm PT.

lee.a: Quick blocker for me: the pricing worksheet references a custom discount code we used last quarter — not sure if finance okays reuse. Tagging @michael.so here for confirmation.

michael.so: I’ll confirm with finance, but likely we need exec approval for that level. Can you add a comment on the sheet with the rationale so I can route?

sanika.s: Attached diagram and two FAQ bullets in the account doc. Also noted network egress checklist for the customer's infra team.

oliver.sec: Dropped SOC2 excerpt and a short BYOK paragraph in the doc. Added an action item: if customer requires HSM vendor attestation, we need 48–72h to gather vendor certs.

jamie.s: great — next steps: (1) @lee.a review SOW (2) @michael.so confirm discount route with finance (3) @sanika.s + @oliver.sec finalize attachable blurbs (4) I’ll schedule pre-demo 3pm PT and follow up. Any other blockers? :thumbsup:

lee.a: All good from me for now. Will post comments by EOD.

jamie.s: thanks team — appreciate the quick turnaround.

sec-bot: Reminder: please ensure any uploaded artifacts with customer data are tagged with "sensitive" per policy.
